selected_proposals.selection_rationale: Primary GEN021-M01 exploit: adds a direct bounded atomwise scalar plus vector-norm energy residual to target the evidence diagnosis that generation_020's physically valid mixer was too muted to affect ISO17 energy/gap within 8 epochs.

Scalar-only ablation of the direct residual mechanism; isolates whether the main benefit comes from a clean atomwise scalar correction rather than vector-norm coupling, preserving interpretability and low runtime risk.

Higher-cap direct residual jump within the same evidence-backed family; tests whether the residual needs the recommended cap to escape the tiny-gate neutral-variance regime observed in generation_020.
Mild late energy/force loss rebalance control for GEN021-M02; diagnoses whether force-dominated training suppresses energy/gap improvements without introducing a new architecture.
Combines the direct residual mechanism with a mild objective shift, testing the evidence-supported hypothesis that the new energy path needs enough scalar supervision during the fixed 8-epoch budget.
Exact source replicate control for generation_020/proposal_003; calibrates benchmark variance before attributing small Q_total, G_delta, energy, force, or gap changes to new mechanisms.
Replaces the muted final mixer with a direct residual, preserving the intended energy-calibration axis while removing the underpowered mechanism that likely caused neutral variance in generation_020.

Training-schedule jump/control for the undertraining diagnosis: keeps a nonzero learning-rate tail to test whether residual pathways failed because cosine annealing reached zero too early under the short benchmark budget.

selection_policy: Prioritize the new grade-A evidence for direct atomwise energy residual calibration and bounded energy/force loss rebalancing, while preserving source recoverability and benchmark semantics. Select three direct-residual mechanism variants, two objective/training diagnostics, one combination proposal, one exact source control, and one backward-simplify replacement of the muted generation_020 mixer. Defer the stronger energy-only schedule and the medium-risk body-order wildcard to avoid over-weighting force/energy objective changes and higher-complexity residuals before the direct-residual family is tested.
selected_mechanism_axes: GEN021-M01 direct atomwise scalar plus vector-norm energy residual
Higher-cap residual variant to escape muted-gate neutral variance
GEN021-M02 mild late energy/force loss rebalance
Tiny residual plus mild objective-rebalance interaction
Replace muted final mixer with direct residual

omitted_proposals.reason: Stronger late energy-emphasis schedule is useful but overlaps with selected proposal_004 and proposal_006; defer it to avoid over-confounding architecture evidence with a more aggressive objective shift.

Body-order-conditioned residual wildcard is higher-complexity and less directly supported than the direct atomwise residual family; defer until cleaner residual and objective controls establish whether extra body-order conditioning is needed.
